title: Differential Rateband Schematic & Cost Composer for Token Attribution and Pricing UI Patterns
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Background: Teams have asked for more fine-grained control and explainability over per-token billing. Current Console views provide breakdowns but none that allow operators to define or preview differential rate bands (e.g., model-specific premiums, quantization discounts, regional multipliers) and immediately see token-attribution lines and exportable line-items for billing reconciliation. This ticket scopes a design prototype: a composable 'Rateband Composer' UI pattern that sits alongside token-level trace and attribution, feeds the cost simulation engine, and produces CSV/JSON exports suitable for downstream chargeback and billing systems.

Goals: Provide a compact visual language for defining rate bands, previewing applied rates on real token traces, enable fast pivoting between aggregation dimensions (model, route, user role), and offer an exportable line-item breakdown that maps back to token spans. Deliver a Figma prototype and handoff-ready spec for engineering.
acceptance_criteria: Design prototype (Figma) showing Rateband Composer and Token Attribution overlay with at least three rateband examples (base, premium, quantized discount).
Interactive flow documented that shows how a trace maps to line-item exports (CSV sample).
Console screen spec with accessibility tokens and responsive behavior (desktop/tablet).
Design review sign-off from PM and two engineers (runtime, billing).
Edge cases documented: overlapping bands, zero-duration tokens, fallback rate behavior.
comments: 2025-02-12 - Maya Chen: Initial kickoff with PM and runtime engineers. Agreed to scope minimal MVP: composer + preview + export. Engineering will provide a CSV schema and sample traces by 02/18.
2025-02-19 - Ethan Park: Uploaded first-pass wireframes. Chose compact band UI over left-hand panel for space reasons. Need to validate color accessibility for stacked bands.
2025-02-25 - Priya Singh (PM): Asked for quick toggle between 'applied to sample traces' and 'apply to historical 7-day window'. Backend support required for sample run - added dependency ENG-2246.

2025-03-01 - Rahul Mehta (Eng - runtime): Confirmed CSV schema and called out performance implication of running sample across >100k traces. Suggested server-side sampling; added note to dependencies.
2025-03-03 - Design review: Feedback to add an explicit 'conflict resolution' affordance when ratebands overlap and a preview of 'effective unit price per token' shown as sparkline next to each band.
notes: Trade-offs considered: inline composer vs modal; opted inline composer to keep user's mental model anchored to the trace. Trade-off: inline increases clutter; mitigated via collapsible sections and condensed chips. Export format: CSV line items ordered by timestamp to allow downstream ledger ingestion. Logging: every applied composer version will be saved as a named preset for audit and reproducibility.
